title: Multimodal Models
tagline: Vision transformers, contrastive learning, vision–language models, speech and image generation
summary: Language models increasingly see, hear and speak. This course covers vision transformers and contrastive image–text learning, vision–language models, speech recognition and synthesis, audio and spoken-dialogue models, the diffusion and autoregressive models that generate images, and models trained natively on many modalities.

chapters.summary: Images as sequences of patches and the ViT architecture.

chapters.title: Contrastive image–text learning
chapters.summary: CLIP-style training, shared embedding spaces and zero-shot classification.

chapters.summary: Connecting image encoders to language models, visual instruction tuning and document understanding.

chapters.summary: Audio features, encoder–decoder speech recognition and neural text-to-speech.

chapters.title: Audio and spoken-dialogue models
chapters.summary: Discrete audio tokens, speech-to-speech models and real-time voice.

chapters.summary: Early-fusion models trained on interleaved text, images, audio and video.
